title: service-knowledge: a knowledge hit's title is read from a hard-coded `title` field
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ① product defect. Source: topic #36990.
Grading: area:ai · Bug · Impeded · rare (apps that mount `service-knowledge`) · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：命中结果的标题只取名为 title 的字段；对象的名称字段叫别的名字时，命中没有标题。
- 修法：按对象定义找出它的名称字段再取值。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. `knowledge-service.ts` `recordToDocument`: pick the field with `resolveDisplayField(schema)` (`packages/spec/src/data/display-name.ts`), then read `record[field]`. Empty or withheld (credential / internal) → `title` undefined.
2. Do not call `resolveRecordDisplayName`: its `Record #<id>` floor is a UI label, not index content.
3. No object definition → fall back to `title` as today.

## Acceptance
- Name field is a formula / autonumber; name field withheld; no object definition.
- Container run per AGENTS.md.

Blocked-by: #36991 (same file), #36839 (its readability check uses the same resolution)
Parent: #36990. Reader: the server lane for `service-knowledge`.
Dedupe: `knowledge hit title` 179 (none on this mechanism).
